world.description: A three-lap kart race along the floor of a sandstone canyon.

hot-air-balloon.description: A detailed hot-air balloon hovering one meter above a subtle ground marker, with a striped lobed teardrop envelope, four-sided rope rigging, woven wicker basket, and twin burner assembly.

height.description: balloon height from basket bottom to envelope crown in meters

saguaro-cactus.description: A detailed, all-around saguaro cactus with a tapered ribbed trunk, configurable upturned arms, crown flowers, and a cohesive desert-green palette.

intro.objective: Race 3 laps — hit every checkpoint in order and ride the boost pads.
intro.tagline: Sandstone, sunshine and two rivals who never brake.
intro.title: Kart Canyon

world.name: Kart Canyon

then.text: Three laps through every checkpoint. Go!

rules.description: Crossing the line after all checkpoints completes a lap

then.text: Chequered flag! Three laps of Kart Canyon.
